rules: New assets use existing weapon classifications and base weapon scale, origin and grip. Conditions inspect the original attack target; source recipients still require that attack to hit. Health percent variables use 0..100.

weapons.name: 潮汐引雷杖
weapons.visual: Slender sea-green staff; open crescent copper fork with three hanging water-drop rods; a small blue reservoir below the fork, clear center gap. Keep base staff grip and overall length.
weapons.rationale: 潮湿铺垫与导电终结两段法术；消耗潮湿换取伤害与一回合眩晕。
weapons.description: 专属技：潮湿铺垫与导电终结两段法术；消耗潮湿换取伤害与一回合眩晕。

weapons.name: 灰烬司炉杖
weapons.visual: Dark iron staff topped by an asymmetric miniature brick-kiln chamber, short side chimney, amber slit and ceramic collar; distinct block-and-chimney silhouette.
weapons.rationale: 先点燃再引爆燃烧；引爆会消耗持续伤害，不是白送额外伤害。
weapons.description: 专属技：先点燃再引爆燃烧；引爆会消耗持续伤害，不是白送额外伤害。

weapons.name: 回枝医者杖
weapons.visual: Pale wooden staff curving into two unequal living branches around a suspended jade bowl, small folded leaf plates and ivory bindings; botanical open shape.
weapons.rationale: 专属友军净化治疗；基础奥术攻击保留。
weapons.description: 专属技：专属友军净化治疗；基础奥术攻击保留。

weapons.name: 镂甲线膛枪
weapons.visual: Long narrow rifle barrel with offset drill-like muzzle sleeve, triangular bronze receiver braces, dark squared stock and compact top sight. Preserve reference rifle trigger, barrel axis, magazine interface and foregrip.
weapons.rationale: 定点破甲射击降低目标防御，随后队友可利用弱点。
weapons.description: 专属技：定点破甲射击降低目标防御，随后队友可利用弱点。

weapons.name: 钟摆守望枪
weapons.visual: Rifle with split curved stock tail, pendulum-shaped underbarrel counterweight near receiver, parallel brass barrel rails and a small circular sight. Keep trigger and magazine clear.
weapons.rationale: 双发压制并获得护卫；用两发弹药换防守稳定性。
weapons.description: 专属技：双发压制并获得护卫；用两发弹药换防守稳定性。

weapons.name: 暮线猎杀枪
weapons.visual: Broad octagonal muzzle, shortened angular upper shroud, long dark stock with crimson inset and tall forked iron sight; hunter silhouette unlike slim rifle.
weapons.rationale: 高弹耗终结弹按目标已失生命增伤，有额外冷却。
weapons.description: 专属技：高弹耗终结弹按目标已失生命增伤，有额外冷却。

weapons.name: 仪典断咒剑
weapons.visual: Slim straight ivory-silver sword with broken-ring guard, small suspended purple seal at guard center, stepped blade shoulder and squared pommel. Preserve iron-sword hilt dimensions and centerline.
weapons.rationale: 命中后驱散敌方增益；伤害略低，面向强化敌人。
weapons.description: 专属技：命中后驱散敌方增益；伤害略低，面向强化敌人。

weapons.name: 赤线采血剑
weapons.visual: Single-edged narrow sword with gently hooked tip, a deep red fuller channel, thin crescent handguard and teardrop pommel; no gore. Same blade length and hilt anchors as reference.
weapons.rationale: 专属采血命中恢复自身4生命，并有75%概率流血；用较弱直伤换持续续航。
weapons.description: 专属技：专属采血命中恢复自身4生命，并有75%概率流血；用较弱直伤换持续续航。

weapons.name: 荆冠赦令剑
weapons.visual: Broad leaf-shaped sword with three scalloped shoulders near the base, green enamel thorn-crown guard and a hollow diamond pommel; hilt remains reference sized.
weapons.rationale: 攻击成功后清除自身减益，必须命中才能自救。
weapons.description: 专属技：攻击成功后清除自身减益，必须命中才能自救。

weapons.name: 钳口压锋大剑
weapons.visual: Two-handed sword with twin blunt jaws flanking the upper blade, a negative-space slit, heavy parallel crossguard and dark wrapped long grip; keep grip and reach reference aligned.
weapons.rationale: 重斩附加虚弱，降低敌方力量而非只增加伤害。
weapons.description: 专属技：重斩附加虚弱，降低敌方力量而非只增加伤害。

weapons.name: 风车巡阵大剑
weapons.visual: Long swept falchion-like two-handed blade with four blade-shoulder fins reminiscent of a windmill, blue cloth-free enamel accents and open circular guard center.
weapons.rationale: 扇扫最多三个近邻目标，单体威力较低。
weapons.description: 专属技：扇扫最多三个近邻目标，单体威力较低。

weapons.name: 残烛守誓大剑
weapons.visual: Long dark tapering sword with a narrow amber candle-like central core, asymmetrical melted-wax bronze guard and a short bell-shaped pommel. Keep a solid usable edge and reference long grip.
weapons.rationale: 失血越多斩击越强；强化有上限，不提供无条件优势。
weapons.description: 专属技：失血越多斩击越强；强化有上限，不提供无条件优势。

weapons.name: 钉城破壁巨剑
weapons.visual: Very broad rectangular siege blade with riveted iron plates, a stepped hammer-like square tip, two large bronze bolts and heavy lower brace. Same giant-sword grip and footprint as base44.
weapons.rationale: 高耐久破坏重击，用低命中和武器磨损换装备破坏。
weapons.description: 专属技：高耐久破坏重击，用低命中和武器磨损换装备破坏。

weapons.name: 寒钟震霜巨剑
weapons.visual: Giant blade with broad bell-shaped blade shoulder, ice-blue faceted inset, open iron bell yoke crossguard and staggered small icicle plates, no transparency needed.
weapons.rationale: 命中施加寒滞；潮湿目标额外被眩晕且潮湿被消耗。
weapons.description: 专属技：命中施加寒滞；潮湿目标额外被眩晕且潮湿被消耗。

weapons.name: 赤潮汲流巨剑
weapons.visual: Giant crescent-cleaver profile with a broad hooked upper tip, three red vent slits near the spine, open wave-shaped guard and bronze conduit along one side.
weapons.rationale: 收割流血目标的状态，追加伤害并治疗自己。
weapons.description: 专属技：收割流血目标的状态，追加伤害并治疗自己。

weapons.name: 蛛纹缚足弓
weapons.visual: Recurve bow with asymmetric spider-leg-like limb braces, three pale tension cords forming a small web near each limb tip, green central grip; match reference grip, bow plane, tips and string path.
weapons.rationale: 带线箭附加迟缓，降低目标速度并改变后续回合排序。
weapons.description: 专属技：带线箭附加迟缓，降低目标速度并改变后续回合排序。

weapons.name: 白鹭分羽弓
weapons.visual: Elegant ivory bow with split forked upper and lower limb ends suggesting egret feathers, cyan inlaid grip and short clean feather-shaped plates; reference bow string stays unobstructed.
weapons.rationale: 分羽箭对两个邻近目标精准射击，保持敌装不受额外磨损。
weapons.description: 专属技：分羽箭对两个邻近目标精准射击，保持敌装不受额外磨损。

weapons.name: 巡墓萃毒弓
weapons.visual: Dark bone-and-wood recurved bow with two small green sealed reservoirs near grip, downward thorn tip shapes and bronze fluid clips; no large object crossing string.
weapons.rationale: 毒箭铺垫与萃毒终结，终结消耗中毒并追加伤害。
weapons.description: 专属技：毒箭铺垫与萃毒终结，终结消耗中毒并追加伤害。

weapons.name: 窑工回火斧
weapons.visual: One-handed axe with wide ceramic-backed wedge head, crescent cutting face, amber kiln slit near eye and an iron scoop-like rear poll; preserve axe70 shaft, hand region and head envelope.
weapons.rationale: 仍可伐木清障；回火劈砍从燃烧目标提取热量并扑灭火焰。
weapons.description: 专属技：仍可伐木清障；回火劈砍从燃烧目标提取热量并扑灭火焰。

weapons.name: 断层寻脉镐
weapons.visual: Two-handed mining pick with an offset split pointed head, small bronze survey dial at the haft junction, turquoise mineral seam inset and a squared hammer back; preserve two-handed shaft grip anchors.
weapons.rationale: 仍可清理石障；寻脉打击无视目标防御（护卫仍减免），并破坏护甲耐久。
weapons.description: 专属技：仍可清理石障；寻脉打击无视目标防御（护卫仍减免），并破坏护甲耐久。

attachments.name: 蒸汽蒸馏冠
attachments.visual: Offset spiral still tube around a squat cyan chamber, broad open funnel and single drip nozzle; compact staff-head mount.
attachments.rationale: 消耗目标潮湿，追加蒸汽伤害。
attachments.description: 法术命中潮湿目标时追加4点基础蒸汽伤害并移除潮湿；直伤降低10%。

attachments.name: 逆燃熄火冠
attachments.visual: Upside-down angular candle-snuffer hood, crimson inner plate and two opposing exhaust horns; distinctive inverted cone silhouette.
attachments.rationale: 引爆并移除燃烧，爆发与持续伤害取舍。
attachments.description: 法术命中燃烧目标时追加5点基础火伤并移除燃烧；直伤降低10%。

attachments.name: 净秽孔雀冠
attachments.visual: Five short peacock-eye bronze paddles in an upright crown, violet oval center and open fan gaps; no previous prism-fan geometry reuse.
attachments.rationale: 攻击命中驱散目标的增益状态。
attachments.description: 法术命中后移除目标增益；直伤降低15%。

attachments.name: 蜜髓啄喙冠
attachments.visual: Curved bird-beak spout with amber honeycomb capsule, ivory three-prong perch and tiny throat reservoir.
attachments.rationale: 命中汲取生命，直伤下降换取自疗。
attachments.description: 法术每次命中恢复自身2生命；直伤降低20%。

attachments.name: 纺血绕线夹
attachments.visual: Side-mounted small bobbin with three angular red threads, two narrow guide wheels and brass spindle fork.
attachments.rationale: 专门追击流血目标，追加伤害但不再附加流血。
attachments.description: 法术命中流血目标时追加3点基础伤害，保留流血；直伤降低5%。

attachments.name: 棘藜解毒夹
attachments.visual: An ivory thistle cage enclosing three jade antidote beads, hooked drain stem and half-circle mounting cuff.
attachments.rationale: 攻击命中时清除自身中毒；保持攻击压力来解毒。
attachments.description: 法术命中后清除自身中毒；直伤降低5%。

attachments.name: 风眼护持夹
attachments.visual: Flattened eye-shaped metal loop with two opposed curved fins, central turquoise pupil shield and short cuff.
attachments.rationale: 命中后为自身获得护卫，降低直伤以稳住站位。
attachments.description: 法术命中后将自身护卫提升至至少2点，不叠加；直伤降低15%。

attachments.name: 回春飞锤
attachments.visual: Small off-center square hammer head sliding on an open bronze arc, jade spring block and short piston foot.
attachments.rationale: 近战命中自身回血；不依赖施法。
attachments.description: 劈砍命中恢复自身3生命；直伤降低15%。

attachments.name: 断咒铡刀架
attachments.visual: Miniature open guillotine frame with diagonal violet plate, twin guide rails and a broad sword-spine clamp.
attachments.rationale: 近战命中有概率移除目标增益。
attachments.description: 劈砍命中有50%概率驱散目标增益；直伤降低5%。

attachments.name: 沸血压舱器
attachments.visual: Heavy asymmetrical kidney-shaped red chamber with gauge needle, two downward iron keel fins and broad mounting foot.
attachments.rationale: 自身血量越低追加伤害越高，牺牲命中。
attachments.description: 自身每失去20%生命，劈砍命中追加1点基础伤害；直伤降低5%，命中-8。

attachments.name: 雨痕导电触媒
attachments.visual: Open zigzag lightning frame around a cyan droplet, bronze sword clip with two ceramic insulators.
attachments.rationale: 提供奥术触媒，法术对潮湿目标追加电伤但保留潮湿。
attachments.description: 提供奥术触媒；法术命中潮湿目标追加3点基础电伤，保留潮湿；直伤降低5%。

attachments.name: 赦毒骨铃触媒
attachments.visual: Two mismatched ivory bell shells suspended from a violet triangular bracket, tiny green clapper and sword-side clip.
attachments.rationale: 提供奥术触媒，命中后清除自身流血与中毒。
attachments.description: 提供奥术触媒；法术命中后清除自身流血与中毒；直伤降低10%。

attachments.name: 裂伤描线导轨
attachments.visual: Narrow horizontal rail carrying a split crimson aiming needle and two small open diamond sights; compact gun/bow-compatible footprint.
attachments.rationale: 物理远程命中流血目标时追加伤害。
attachments.description: 枪弓物理命中流血目标追加3点基础伤害，保留流血；直伤降低5%。

attachments.name: 解甲楔形导轨
attachments.visual: Short top rail with three staggered brass wedges and an offset square receiver plate, distinct low wedge silhouette.
attachments.rationale: 命中附加破甲状态，降低目标防御。
attachments.description: 枪弓物理命中有35%概率施加2回合破甲（防御-2）；直伤降低10%。

attachments.name: 回声分叉导轨
attachments.visual: Two diverging blue fork vanes from a low center rail, small paired tuning discs and a clear central aiming channel.
attachments.rationale: 以直伤换取一个邻近追加目标，枪弓共用。
attachments.description: 枪弓物理伤害降低30%，可命中主目标1格内的合法敌人，目标总上限提高至至少2人；已有更高上限时不叠加，冷却+1。

attachments.name: 末程刻度导轨
attachments.visual: Long thin dark rail with tall crescent terminal sight, ivory notched gauge spine and a small amber end bead.
attachments.rationale: 目标生命越低追加伤害越高，牺牲射程。
attachments.description: 每8点目标已失生命追加1点基础伤害，最多6点；直伤降低5%，射程-1。

attachments.name: 盐晶止血刃夹
attachments.visual: Twin ivory salt-crystal plates in a small bronze edge saddle, flat red wick beneath and a tiny curved drain.
attachments.rationale: 近战命中流血目标后回血并消耗流血。
attachments.description: 攻击命中后，若目标仍存活且流血，则恢复自身4生命并清除其全部流血；直伤降低10%。

attachments.name: 裂甲铆钉刃夹
attachments.visual: Three heavy offset iron rivet punches with small serrated brass foot, compact one-sided edge mounting bracket.
attachments.rationale: 追加低伤害破甲打击，重点增加目标装备磨损。
attachments.description: 近战命中追加1点基础伤害，扣血时额外损伤目标装备12耐久；直伤降低10%。

attachments.name: 雾水淬锋刃夹
attachments.visual: Flattened cyan water capsule feeding two tiny curved nozzles across an ivory U-shaped blade clamp.
attachments.rationale: 命中施加潮湿，可灭火并配合导电武器。
attachments.description: 近战命中施加潮湿，扑灭燃烧并阻止点燃；直伤降低10%。

attachments.name: 猎毒刻槽刃夹
attachments.visual: Three stepped jade channels held inside a dark open triangular clamp, small upward fang and bronze drain cup.
attachments.rationale: 对中毒目标追加伤害后消耗中毒，转化持续伤害为爆发。
attachments.description: 近战命中中毒目标追加4点基础伤害并消耗全部中毒；直伤降低5%。

buffs.name: 迟缓
buffs.description: 速度降低3，持续2回合；影响后续回合排序。

buffs.name: 震晕
buffs.description: 跳过接下来的1个行动回合。

skills.name: 引潮飞矢
skills.description: 命中造成水系伤害并施加3回合潮湿，扑灭燃烧。

skills.name: 导电裁决
skills.description: 造成奥术伤害；潮湿目标额外受电伤并震晕1回合，随后消耗潮湿。

skills.name: 引炉火
skills.description: 命中造成火焰伤害并点燃3回合；潮湿目标不能被点燃。

skills.name: 炉心引爆
skills.description: 造成火焰伤害；燃烧目标承受额外伤害，随后移除燃烧。

skills.name: 回枝赦伤
skills.description: 净化一名友军的减益和控制状态，再恢复8+智力的生命；不能复活。

skills.name: 镂甲定点射击
skills.description: 消耗1发，伤害只计入目标60%防御；命中施加2回合破甲（防御-2）。

skills.name: 钟摆双发
skills.description: 连续射击2发，每发独立命中并造成较低伤害；每次命中令自身护卫提升至至少3点，不叠加。

skills.name: 暮线终结弹
skills.description: 消耗2发弹药凝成一次射击；按目标已失生命的30%追加伤害，至多10点基础值。

skills.name: 仪典断咒
skills.description: 命中造成伤害，随后移除目标的增益状态。

skills.name: 赤线采血
skills.description: 命中恢复自身4点生命，并有75%概率使目标流血；直接伤害较低且不磨损目标装备。

skills.name: 荆冠赦令
skills.description: 命中敌人后，清除自身的减益和控制状态；未命中无净化。

skills.name: 钳口压锋
skills.description: 重击并令目标虚弱2回合，力量降低3。

skills.name: 巡阵扇扫
skills.description: 攻击主目标及其1格内最多两名合法敌人；每名目标必须仍在自身1格射程与视线内。

skills.name: 残烛誓斩
skills.description: 按自身已失生命的25%增加伤害，至多10点基础值；伤势越重威力越大。

skills.name: 钉城破壁
skills.description: 沉重一击：命中扣血后使目标身体甲、头盔、盾牌各损失30耐久，致死追加20；自身武器损耗3。

skills.name: 寒钟震霜
skills.description: 命中施加2回合迟缓（速度-3）；若目标潮湿，额外震晕1回合并消耗潮湿。

skills.name: 赤潮汲流
skills.description: 命中判定成功后，先从流血目标汲取6点生命并追加6点基础伤害，再完成斩击，最后清除目标全部流血。

skills.name: 蛛纹缚足箭
skills.description: 命中施加2回合迟缓，速度降低3；不限制移动距离。

skills.name: 白鹭分羽
skills.description: 射向主目标及其1格内另一名合法敌人，最多两目标；不磨损目标装备。

skills.name: 巡墓毒箭
skills.description: 命中施加中毒，可叠加到3层，持续4回合。

skills.name: 萃毒终结箭
skills.description: 命中中毒目标时追加7点基础伤害，随后清除目标全部中毒。

skills.name: 窑工回火
skills.description: 命中判定成功后，先从燃烧目标提取热量，将自身护卫提升至至少4点并追加5点基础伤害，再完成劈砍并扑灭目标燃烧。

skills.name: 断层寻脉
skills.description: 寻脉打击无视目标防御（仍受护卫减免），扣血时破坏16装备耐久，致死追加8。
